```{r data_import}
#read_file
feature_table <- read_csv("featuretable_reformated.csv")
library_matches <- read_tsv("merged_results_with_gnps.tsv")
metadata <- read_csv("Metadata_500food.csv") %>% arrange(filename)

#data_transpose
data_transpose <- feature_table %>% 
  column_to_rownames("row ID") %>% 
  dplyr::select(contains(".mzML")) %>% 
  t() %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  rownames_to_column("filename")

#remove Peak area from filename from feature table
data_transpose$filename <- gsub(" Peak area", "", data_transpose$filename)
data_transpose <- data_transpose %>% arrange(filename)

m_filter <- metadata %>%
  filter(!str_detect(filename, "QC")) %>%
  filter(!str_detect(sample_type_group3, "mineral|game meat|water|insect|reptile|sap|invertebrate")) %>%
  filter(!str_detect(sample_type_group4, "mouse|rat|tea")) %>%
  filter(!str_detect(filename, "P1_F10_G75112")) %>%
  filter(!str_detect(description, "lapacho")) %>%
  filter(!str_detect(sample_type_group1, "algae|fungi"))

data_transpose <- data_transpose %>% 
  filter(filename %in% m_filter$filename)

#rclr normalisation
data_clr <- codaSeq.clr(column_to_rownames(data_transpose, var = "filename")+ 1) %>% as.data.frame() 
clr_data <- data_clr %>%  rownames_to_column("filename") %>% arrange(filename)
clr_data$filename <- trimws(clr_data$filename)

#TIC normalisation
# Set the row names using the 'filename' column
Sample_tic <- column_to_rownames(data_transpose, var = "filename")
Sample_tic <- t(Sample_tic) %>% as.data.frame()
Sample_tic <- Sample_tic + 1
Sample_tic <- sweep(Sample_tic, 1, rowSums(Sample_tic), FUN = "/")
Sample_tic <- Sample_tic * 1e7
Sample_tic <- t(Sample_tic) %>% as.data.frame()
Sample_tic <- sweep(Sample_tic, 1, rowSums(Sample_tic), FUN = "/")
Sample_tic <- Sample_tic * 1e7
Sample_tic <- Sample_tic %>% rownames_to_column("filename")

#filter_data
filter_data <- clr_data %>%
  filter(filename %in% m_filter$filename) 
m_filter <- m_filter %>% 
  filter(filename %in% filter_data$filename) %>%
  arrange(filename)
```


```{r PCA}
#PCA analysis#
PCA_whole <- mixOmics::pca(filter_data, ncomp = 4, scale = TRUE)
PCA_whole_scores <- data.frame(PCA_whole$variates$X, m_filter)
PCA_plot <- PCA_whole_scores %>%
  ggscatter(x = "PC1", y = "PC2", color = "sample_type_group1", alpha = 1, size = 2,
            title = paste("PCA", "Simple Foods", sep = " "),
            xlab = paste("PC1 (", round(PCA_whole$prop_expl_var$X[1]*100, digits = 2),"%)", sep = ""), 
            ylab = paste("PC2 (", round(PCA_whole$prop_expl_var$X[2]*100, digits = 2),"%)", sep = ""),
            ggtheme = theme_bw()) +
  stat_ellipse(aes(colour = sample_type_group1), alpha = 1) + 
  geom_point(
    data = PCA_whole_scores %>% 
      group_by(sample_type_group1) %>% 
      summarise(across(matches("PC"), mean)),  # Calculate mean PC1 and PC2
    aes(PC1, PC2, color = sample_type_group1), 
    size = 4, 
    shape = 8  # Star-shaped marker for centroids
  ) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 20, colour = "black"),
        axis.title = element_text(size = 20),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold"),
        panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", size = 1.5)) +  # Adjust border color and thickness here
  coord_fixed()

plot(PCA_plot)
```

```{r Loop categories for biomarkers}
library(mixOmics)
library(tidyverse)

### 1. PREPARE DATA ###

# The grouping variable is stored in sample_group.
sample_group <- PCA_whole_scores$sample_type_group2
PCA_whole_scores$sample_type_group2 <- as.factor(sample_group)

# Prepare numeric data for PLS-DA.
filter_data <- filter_data %>%
  column_to_rownames("filename") %>%
  dplyr::select(where(is.numeric))

# Prepare data from data_transpose.
Global <- data_transpose %>%
  column_to_rownames("filename") %>%
  t() %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column("#Scan#")

# Optionally, select only specific columns (if needed)
Global <- Global[, grep("J|G|F|P|Scan", colnames(Global))]
Global <- Global %>% column_to_rownames("#Scan#")

### 2. FILTER CATEGORIES WITH AT LEAST 10 SAMPLES ###

# Count samples per category
sample_counts <- m_filter %>%
  group_by(sample_type_group2) %>%
  summarise(N = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(N))

cat("========== SAMPLE COUNTS PER CATEGORY ==========\n")
print(sample_counts)

# Keep only categories with >= 10 samples
min_samples <- 10
categories <- sample_counts %>%
  filter(N >= min_samples) %>%
  pull(sample_type_group2)

excluded_categories <- sample_counts %>%
  filter(N < min_samples) %>%
  pull(sample_type_group2)

cat("\n========== CATEGORY FILTERING SUMMARY ==========\n")
cat("Minimum samples required:", min_samples, "\n")
cat("Categories INCLUDED (>= 10 samples):", paste(categories, collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat("Number of categories included:", length(categories), "\n\n")

if (length(excluded_categories) > 0) {
  cat("Categories EXCLUDED (< 10 samples):", paste(excluded_categories, collapse = ", "), "\n")
  cat("Number of categories excluded:", length(excluded_categories), "\n\n")
}

# 3. LOOP OVER FILTERED CATEGORIES ###

all_features <- data.frame()  # To store features passing both filters
ber_results <- data.frame()   # To store BER for each category

for (cat in categories) {

  cat("\nProcessing category:", cat, "\n")

  #### A. PLS-DA & VIP Extraction ####

  # Create a binary grouping: current category vs. all others
  binary_group <- ifelse(m_filter$sample_type_group2 == cat, cat, "Other")

  # Run PLS-DA using the numeric data.
  PLSDA_model <- mixOmics::plsda(filter_data, binary_group, ncomp = 5, scale = TRUE)

  #### CALCULATE BER ####
  # Get predicted classes on the training set
  predicted_classes <- predict(PLSDA_model, filter_data)$class$max.dist[, 5]  # Using 5 components

  # Create confusion matrix
  confusion_matrix <- table(Predicted = predicted_classes, Actual = binary_group)

  # Calculate BER (Balanced Error Rate)
  # BER = 1 - (1/2) * (TP/P + TN/N)
  # Or equivalently: BER = (1/2) * (FN/P + FP/N)

  # Extract values from confusion matrix
  if (nrow(confusion_matrix) == 2 && ncol(confusion_matrix) == 2) {
    # Standard 2x2 case
    TP <- confusion_matrix[2, 2]  # True Positives (predicted cat, actual cat)
    FN <- confusion_matrix[1, 2]  # False Negatives (predicted Other, actual cat)
    FP <- confusion_matrix[2, 1]  # False Positives (predicted cat, actual Other)
    TN <- confusion_matrix[1, 1]  # True Negatives (predicted Other, actual Other)

    P <- TP + FN  # Total positives (actual cat)
    N <- FP + TN  # Total negatives (actual Other)

    sensitivity <- TP / P  # True Positive Rate
    specificity <- TN / N  # True Negative Rate
    ber <- 1 - (1/2) * (sensitivity + specificity)
  } else {
    # Handle edge cases where one class might be completely absent in predictions
    ber <- NA
    sensitivity <- NA
    specificity <- NA
  }

  # Store BER results
  ber_row <- data.frame(
    Category = cat,
    BER = ber,
    Sensitivity = sensitivity,
    Specificity = specificity,
    nComp = 5,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )

  ber_results <- bind_rows(ber_results, ber_row)

  #### Extract VIP scores and loadings ####
  vip_scores <- mixOmics::vip(PLSDA_model)
  loadings   <- as.data.frame(PLSDA_model$loadings$X)

  # Combine into a results data frame.
  vip_results <- data.frame(
    Feature  = rownames(vip_scores),
    VIP      = vip_scores[, 1],
    Loading  = loadings[, 1],
    category = cat,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )

  # Filter for features with VIP > 4
  important_vip <- vip_results %>% filter(VIP > 2)

  cat("  VIP > 4 features found:", nrow(important_vip), "\n")

  #### B. Fold-Change Evaluation on VIP-Passing Features ####

  # Use only features that passed the VIP filter.
  matching_features <- important_vip$Feature

  if (length(matching_features) > 0) {

    # Subset Global to keep only rows (features) in matching_features.
    local <- Global %>%
      rownames_to_column("#Scan#") %>%
      filter(`#Scan#` %in% matching_features) %>%
      column_to_rownames("#Scan#")

    # Get sample filenames for the current category and the others.
    sample_files <- m_filter %>%
      filter(sample_type_group2 == cat) %>%
      pull(filename)

    other_files  <- m_filter %>%
      filter(sample_type_group2 != cat) %>%
      pull(filename)

    # Create regex patterns to select columns.
    pattern_cat   <- paste(sample_files, collapse = "|")
    pattern_other <- paste(other_files, collapse = "|")

    # Subset local into category and non-category data.
    category_data     <- local %>% dplyr::select(matches(pattern_cat))
    non_category_data <- local %>% dplyr::select(matches(pattern_other))

    # Proceed only if both groups have data.
    if (ncol(category_data) > 0 && ncol(non_category_data) > 0) {

      # Compute the row means for each feature.
      category_means     <- rowMeans(category_data, na.rm = TRUE)
      non_category_means <- rowMeans(non_category_data, na.rm = TRUE)

      # Calculate fold-change (assuming non_category_means are nonzero)
      fold_change <- category_means / non_category_means

      # Create a fold-change data frame.
      foldchange_df <- data.frame(
        Feature    = names(fold_change),
        FoldChange = fold_change,
        category   = cat,
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )

      # Filter for features with fold-change > 4.
      passed_both <- foldchange_df %>% filter(FoldChange > 2)

      # Mark these features as having passed both criteria.
      if (nrow(passed_both) > 0) {
        passed_both <- passed_both %>% mutate(Method = "VIP+FoldChange")
      }

      cat("  Features passing VIP+FC filters:", nrow(passed_both), "\n")

    } else {
      passed_both <- data.frame()
      cat("  No data in one of the groups\n")
    }

  } else {
    passed_both <- data.frame()
    cat("  No VIP > 4 features found\n")
  }

  #### C. Append Results ####

  # Only append features that passed both the VIP and fold-change thresholds.
  all_features <- bind_rows(all_features, passed_both)

}

### 4. Summarize Biomarkers ###

biomarkers <- all_features %>%
  group_by(Feature) %>%
  summarise(
    category = paste(unique(category), collapse = ", "),
    Method   = paste(unique(Method), collapse = ", ")
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  as.data.frame()

### 5. VIEW OR SAVE RESULTS ###

cat("\n\n========== FINAL BIOMARKER SUMMARY ==========\n")
cat("Total biomarkers found:", nrow(all_features), "\n")
cat("Unique biomarkers:", nrow(biomarkers), "\n\n")

cat("Biomarkers per category:\n")
print(all_features %>%
  group_by(category) %>%
  summarise(N = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(N)))

cat("\n")
head(all_features, 10)

cat("\n")
head(ber_results)

# Export BER results to CSV
write.csv(ber_results, "PLSDA_BER_results_filtered_min10samples_level2.csv", row.names = FALSE)

# Export biomarker results
write.csv(all_features, "biomarkers_features_FCvalues_filtered_min10samples_level2.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(biomarkers, "enriched_features_level2.csv", row.names = FALSE)

# Export sample count summary
#write.csv(sample_counts, "sample_counts_by_category.csv", row.names = FALSE)

cat("\n========== FILES EXPORTED ==========\n")
cat("1. PLSDA_BER_results_filtered_min10samples.csv\n")
cat("2. biomarkers_features_FCvalues_filtered_min10samples.csv\n")
cat("3. biomarkers_filtered_min10samples.csv\n")
cat("4. sample_counts_by_category.csv\n")

```


```{r multiple-critiria}

library(mixOmics)
library(tidyverse)
library(pROC)
biomarker_quality_metrics <- data.frame()

for (cat in categories) {
  cat("Processing category:", cat, "\n")
  
  # Get biomarkers for this category
  cat_biomarkers <- all_features %>% filter(category == cat)
  
  if (nrow(cat_biomarkers) > 0) {
    binary_group <- ifelse(m_filter$sample_type_group3 == cat, cat, "Other")
    binary_numeric <- ifelse(binary_group == cat, 1, 0)
    
    # Train PLS-DA for this category
    PLSDA_model <- mixOmics::plsda(filter_data, binary_group, ncomp = 5, scale = TRUE)
    
    # Get VIP scores and loadings
    vip_scores <- mixOmics::vip(PLSDA_model)
    loadings <- as.data.frame(PLSDA_model$loadings$X)
    
    # Get sample files
    sample_files <- m_filter %>% filter(sample_type_group3 == cat) %>% pull(filename)
    other_files  <- m_filter %>% filter(sample_type_group3 != cat) %>% pull(filename)
    
    pattern_cat   <- paste(sample_files, collapse = "|")
    pattern_other <- paste(other_files, collapse = "|")
    
    for (feature in cat_biomarkers$Feature) {
      if (feature %in% rownames(Global)) {
        # Get abundance values
        cat_values <- Global[feature, ] %>% dplyr::select(matches(pattern_cat)) %>% as.numeric()
        other_values <- Global[feature, ] %>% dplyr::select(matches(pattern_other)) %>% as.numeric()
        
        # Remove NAs
        cat_values <- cat_values[!is.na(cat_values)]
        other_values <- other_values[!is.na(other_values)]
        
        if (length(cat_values) > 1 && length(other_values) > 1) {
          
          # 1. EFFECT SIZE (Cohen's d)
          mean_diff <- mean(cat_values, na.rm = TRUE) - mean(other_values, na.rm = TRUE)
          sd_cat <- sd(cat_values, na.rm = TRUE)
          sd_other <- sd(other_values, na.rm = TRUE)
          pooled_sd <- sqrt((sd_cat^2 + sd_other^2) / 2)
          cohens_d <- abs(mean_diff / pooled_sd)
          
          # 2. FOLD-CHANGE
          mean_cat <- mean(cat_values, na.rm = TRUE)
          mean_other <- mean(other_values, na.rm = TRUE)
          fold_change <- mean_cat / mean_other
          
          # 3. P-VALUE (t-test)
          t_test <- t.test(cat_values, other_values)
          pvalue <- t_test$p.value
          
          # 4. VIP SCORE
          vip_score <- ifelse(feature %in% rownames(vip_scores), 
                              vip_scores[feature, 1], 
                              NA)
          
          # 5. LOADING
          loading <- ifelse(feature %in% rownames(loadings), 
                           abs(loadings[feature, 1]), 
                           NA)
          
          # 6. COEFFICIENT OF VARIATION (stability)
          cv_cat <- sd_cat / mean_cat
          cv_other <- sd_other / mean_other
          mean_cv <- mean(c(cv_cat, cv_other), na.rm = TRUE)
          
          # 7. ROC-AUC for this specific feature (WITH PROPER NA HANDLING)
          feature_abundance <- as.numeric(filter_data[feature, ])
          feature_sd <- sd(feature_abundance, na.rm = TRUE)
          
          # Check if SD is valid AND not NA
          if (!is.na(feature_sd) && feature_sd > 0) {
            tryCatch({
              roc_obj <- roc(response = binary_numeric, predictor = feature_abundance, quiet = TRUE)
              auc_value <- as.numeric(auc(roc_obj))
            }, error = function(e) {
              auc_value <<- NA
            })
          } else {
            auc_value <- NA
          }
          
          # Compile metrics
          metrics_row <- data.frame(
            Feature = feature,
            Category = cat,
            Cohens_d = cohens_d,
            FoldChange = fold_change,
            Pvalue = pvalue,
            VIP_Score = vip_score,
            Loading = loading,
            MeanCV = mean_cv,
            AUC = auc_value,
            N_Category = length(cat_values),
            N_Other = length(other_values),
            stringsAsFactors = FALSE
          )
          
          biomarker_quality_metrics <- bind_rows(biomarker_quality_metrics, metrics_row)
        }
      }
    }
  }
}

### 2. DEFINE HIGH-QUALITY THRESHOLDS ###

thresholds <- list(
  cohens_d_min = 0.8,              # Large effect size
  fold_change_min = 4,              # At least 4-fold change
  pvalue_max = 0.001,               # Stringent p-value
  vip_score_min = 2.0,              # Good VIP score
  auc_min = 0.85,                   # Good discriminative power
  mean_cv_max = 0.3                 # Low coefficient of variation (stable)
)

### 3. FILTER FOR HIGH-QUALITY BIOMARKERS ###

high_quality_biomarkers <- biomarker_quality_metrics %>%
  filter(
    Cohens_d >= thresholds$cohens_d_min &
    FoldChange >= thresholds$fold_change_min &
    VIP_Score >= thresholds$vip_score_min
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Cohens_d), desc(AUC))

### 4. CREATE FILTERED BIOMARKER SET ###

high_quality_features <- all_features %>%
  semi_join(high_quality_biomarkers, by = c("Feature", "category" = "Category"))

### 5. EXPORT RESULTS ###

write.csv(high_quality_biomarkers, "biomarker_high_quality_metrics.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(high_quality_features, "biomarkers_high_quality_level3.csv", row.names = FALSE)

### 6. PRINT SUMMARY ###

cat("\n=== HIGH-QUALITY BIOMARKERS SUMMARY ===\n")
cat("Total biomarkers identified:", nrow(all_features), "\n")
cat("High-quality biomarkers retained:", nrow(high_quality_biomarkers), "\n")
cat("Retention rate:", round(nrow(high_quality_biomarkers) / nrow(all_features) * 100, 1), "%\n\n")

cat("=== BIOMARKERS BY CATEGORY ===\n")
summary_by_cat <- high_quality_biomarkers %>%
  group_by(Category) %>%
  summarise(
    N = n(),
    Mean_Cohens_d = round(mean(Cohens_d, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    Mean_AUC = round(mean(AUC, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    Mean_FoldChange = round(mean(FoldChange, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(N))
print(summary_by_cat)

cat("\n=== TOP 15 HIGH-QUALITY BIOMARKERS ===\n")
top_biomarkers <- high_quality_biomarkers %>%
  arrange(desc(Cohens_d)) %>%
  head(15) %>%
  dplyr::select(Feature, Category, Cohens_d, FoldChange, AUC, VIP_Score, Pvalue)
print(top_biomarkers)

cat("\n=== THRESHOLDS APPLIED ===\n")
for (name in names(thresholds)) {
  cat(sprintf("%s: %g\n", name, thresholds[[name]]))
}
```
